cohort: 155 pregnant women with singleton gestations at or beyond 36 weeks who presented with premature rupture of membranes and underwent induction of labor
finding: Foley catheters significantly shortened the interval to delivery compared to misoprostol for cervical ripening in women with premature rupture of membranes at or near term.
mod_finding: There was no increased risk for cesarean delivery in women treated with Foley catheters compared to misoprostol.
